verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation of a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Datadog's core platform. Community comments point the other way: one says replicating Datadog self-hosted would mean building an alternative, and another notes there is no local option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
